title: solanum ipomoea var. ipomoeoides
intro: Solanum ipomoea var. ipomoeoides, commonly known as the "Wild Potato", is a perennial plant native to Australia. It is a member of the Solanaceae family, which includes other edible plants like potatoes and tomatoes. The Wild Potato has been traditionally used in Australian herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The bioactive constituents of the plant include solasodine and solanum alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
